text:
lena_priv: FYI we're rolling an RBAC role refactor for onprem/controlplane tomorrow 09:00 PT. I adjusted admin -> platform-admin mapping; need a quick sanity check on VPC allowlist enforcement for Dedicated customers. Any objections?

anita: can you paste the exact mapping change? worried about svc-acct perms for kube-proxy.

lena_priv: sure, pasted below:
```
roles:
  - name: platform-admin
    inherits: [admin]
    grants:
      - system:kube-proxy:write
      - kms:decrypt
``` 

sec-bot: Audit alert: role_mapping.update by lena_priv at 1923456790 — change staged, awaiting rollout.

jmiller: I'll run smoke tests against staging private-controlplane. Command I'm using:
```
./tools/check-roles.sh --env=staging --check=allowlist,kms
``` 

maya_eng: heads-up: onprem deployments using delegated tokens hit 403 on staging earlier; likely cluster-role missing `impersonate` for svc-acct.

devops-jen: re: KMS: make sure we attach kms:encrypt to infra-service-account in the role binding, otherwise unwrap will fail on private CP.

ryan: if allowlist breaks, dedicated customers will get 403 on controlplane API. we need automated rollback and a canary subset. who can add it?

lena_priv: added a canary flag in rollout config and assigned canary group: [brightline, internal-test3]. created issue ENGOPS-4123.

oliver_pm: FYI Brightline is in dedicated-asia region and requires audit logs forwarded to their SIEM — include them in canary? they have stricter compliance.

jmiller: smoke tests show allowlist enforcement is ok, but audit logs for delegated tokens miss `subject` field intermittently. Filing infra ticket.

sec-bot: New ticket created: ENGSEC-987 - delegated-token audit logs missing subject. Priority: P2.

anita: also saw this error in onprem-1 logs during KMS bind trial:
```
2026-03-19T18:42:10Z ERROR: KMS_UNAUTHORIZED caller=infra-svcacct action=decrypt resource=projects/prod/keys/cp-key
```

lena_priv: OK we will pause rollout for 30m while infra adds audit header and we run canary. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

devops-jen: leaving a note — after rollback window we'll run a full regression for onprem edgecases.

ryan: tagging compliance to record change: @compliance

lena_priv: noted, recording change in runbook and will add post-mortem checklist if anything pops.
